spellbook.finance/limitations: Facts represent observed Limitless tournament decklists from the previous 30 days; absence is unknown, not zero usage or zero demand.
Catalog price may be missing for an observed card. Missing prices and incomplete event coverage remain named in the response.
Format rotation legality is not inferred from observed decklists.

description: Read observed Pokemon card demand facts for one exact catalog product, optionally narrowed to one format. The response preserves exact card identity, sample windows, counts, prices, coverage, missingFields and limitations. It reports observations and does not rank or recommend a card.

cardId.description: Exact Pokemon catalog product id from spellbook_printings_search. Required.

limit.description: Maximum observations to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: spellbook_pokemon_metagame_card
